invariants.description: Rendered CRM fact fields and evidence references must resolve to retrieved source records
Task creation requires an approved, session-bound server proposal and is idempotent
Scope, underlying records and mode remain visible; AI failure does not break Explore
Secrets stay server-side and provider failures are not exposed as raw sensitive errors
Scripted mock mode is explicitly identified and never replaces failed live mode silently
Completion claims bind to exact evidence; deferred live checks are not passed

checks.description: Capture gate covers every source, requirement and invariant
State, append-only events, review findings and evidence are published and readable
Pinned dependency lock, typecheck and production Next build pass
Shared shadcn/Base UI primitives and Tailwind tokens; no competing component system
Deterministic customers/deals/activities/tasks inspectable; local demo survives store reopen
PostgreSQL migration, seed and Drizzle adapter integration pass against CI PostgreSQL
Summary/list/deal/context/activities tools return validated facts and bounded output
Invalid IDs, missing data and unrelated evidence cannot be presented as sourced facts

requirements.title: AI SDK real adapter and transparent mock mode

Mock adapter exercises same tool/store boundary, is labelled scripted, and validates canonical scenarios
Live missing credentials/provider failure never silently falls back; loop, prompt and time limits enforced
Live DeepSeek quality and provider compatibility smoke test

checks.description: Focus, Investigation and Comparison render from validated discriminated output
Fact hydration rejects unobserved IDs; no eval, generated JSX or arbitrary component registry
Source evidence, timeline, recommendation and addressable persisted run can be inspected

requirements.title: Today, Explore and usable interaction states

checks.description: Totals, mode, scope and source access remain visible
Explore tables/pipeline/customers/activities/tasks and manual task path work without LLM
Loading, error, cancellation, empty, keyboard and narrow screen paths are tested
Proposal -> explicit approval -> task creation -> Explore reflection works end to end
Repeat approval creates no duplicate; rejected, expired or other-session proposals cannot execute
Server executes stored payload, not arbitrary browser/model supplied mutation arguments
Vitest, PostgreSQL integration and Playwright demo flow pass on a recorded source revision
Origin/session/access boundaries, input limits, error redaction and secret handling reviewed/tested
Automated accessibility and responsive checks plus fresh review findings recorded
README/env/setup/live-smoke guide and MVP limitation documentation match implementation
PR, source-bound evidence and final continuity checkpoint distinguish passed/deferred/blocked checks
